subject: FoundersSpark — cohort package exception request
messages:
From: Leah Kim <leah@founderspark.vc>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marta Alvarez <marta@founderspark.vc>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: expanded cohort credits & promo extension

Hi Jonas,

FounderSpark is lining up our winter cohort (starts Jan 10) and we have a few portfolio teams that want to prototype with Redwood during the full 6-month program. Onboarding has been great so far — the devs loved the latency and the batch tooling — but the standard accelerator package (50k credits / 3 months) won't cover the type of RLHF and eval runs several teams are planning.

High level ask: can Redwood provide an exception so we can offer the cohort 200k credits over 6 months (rather than 50k / 3mo)? We understand this is outside the standard promo and are open to an MOU or capped overage. If possible we'd also like a partner badge/short co-marketing blurb.

Cohort size: ~12 teams
Estimated avg token usage per team: 10–25M tokens over 6 months (varies by team)

Attached is a short cohort plan for context.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call this week to go over details.

Leah Kim
Head of Partnerships | FounderSpark Accelerator
leah@founderspark.vc
(415) 555-0198

Attachment: founderspark_cohort_plan.xlsx

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Leah Kim <leah@founderspark.vc>
Cc: Marta Alvarez <marta@founderspark.vc>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: expanded cohort credits & promo extension

Hi Leah — great to hear the teams are already seeing value. Short answers up front: we can be flexible, but I need to confirm internal approvals and propose a structure that protects both sides (usage cap + overage pricing).

Before I escalate, two quick clarifying items:
- Do the teams expect to run long RLHF fine-tuning (hours/days), or are they planning short instruction-tuning and eval-heavy workloads?
- Do you need the credits as a single pool for the cohort, or should it be per-team allocations?

My initial play: we can offer a custom cohort bundle (200k credits over 6 months) with a capped monthly burn per team and a discounted overage rate. I'll pull pricing and a draft MOU and loop in Marissa and Aditya for approvals.

I can do a 30-min call Fri 10am PT if that works.

— Jonas
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: FoundersSpark cohort — exception request (proposal attached)

Marissa / Aditya — forwarding FoundersSpark's ask. Summary: they want 200k credits across a 6-month cohort for ~12 teams. Theyre open to an MOU and a usage cap.

Proposal attached (rwd_fs_proposal_v1.pdf):
- 200k credits pool, valid 6 months from activation
- Per-team soft cap: 25k credits/month, with overage at a discounted rate (30% off list)
- Co-marketing mention and partner badge on our partner page
- MOU requiring acceptance of Redwood's acceptable use & data retention terms

My ask: approval to offer this as a one-off promotional bundle. If approved I will send an MOU + DocuSign and coordinate finance for billing/tracking.

If you'd rather offer a smaller bundle (e.g., 125k) or include a revenue-share sponsor option, say the word — I can present both to Leah.

Thanks,
Jonas

Attachment: rwd_fs_proposal_v1.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:41:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: FoundersSpark cohort — exception request (proposal attached)

Jonas — thanks for the summary and draft. Im comfortable approving a cohort exception with the following guardrails:

- Offer 200k credits for 6 months as proposed, with a per-team soft cap of 25k/mo.
- Overage billed at 30% off list price, but finance must sign off on revenue recognition cadence (we'll set a pre-paid ledger entry tied to the deal id).
- Require a one-page MOU (simple commercial terms + usage cap + termination if abuse) and a short security attestation from FounderSpark (SOC2 or equivalent statement for any data they host).
- We add a clause limiting API access to pinned model versions for the cohort (to avoid heavy long fine-tune infra usage unless we explicitly approve).

Aditya — can you confirm we can support the 30% discount on overage from a pricing standpoint and flag any billing implications? Finance: if you prefer, we can do a $X prepay for the 200k credits and then invoice overage monthly.

Jonas — once Aditya confirms, send the MOU and DocuSign link to Leah and schedule the kickoff. Mark me on the DocuSign for visibility.

—Marissa
VP, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Leah Kim <leah@founderspark.vc>, Marta Alvarez <marta@founderspark.vc>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 13:04:00 -0800
Subject: Approved: FounderSpark cohort — terms & next steps

Hi Leah / Marta — thanks for your patience. Good news: leadership approved a one-off cohort bundle. Below are the agreed commercial terms and next steps.

Summary of approved terms (final):
- Cohort bundle: 200,000 credits total, valid for 6 months from activation
- Allocation: cohort-level pool; we will create per-team allocations and monitor for heavy deviation
- Per-team soft cap: 25,000 credits / month (teams that need higher will request an exception)
- Overage: billed monthly at 30% off list price (pre-approved by Sales Ops)
- Security/compliance: FounderSpark to provide a short security attestation (SOC2 type statement) before activation
- Usage constraints: API access limited to pinned model versions (no heavy fine-tune infra without prior approval)
- Co-marketing: Redwood will provide a partner badge and short quote for your website; well coordinate the copy after MOU sign-off

Attachments: RWD-FS-MOU-20261118.pdf (one-page MOU), rwd_fs_proposal_v1.pdf
DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/RWD-FS-20261118
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/FS-0321

Next steps:
1) Leah: review and confirm the terms above; supply the security attestation.
2) I will send the DocuSign for the one-page MOU; Marissa will be on the signature chain for visibility.
3) Once signed and attestation received, Finance will set up the cohort pool and activate credits (usually 3–5 business days).

If this all looks good I can schedule a kickoff and send onboarding notes to the teams. Thanks — excited to get FounderSpark up and running.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132
